items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: No, not too much. More than a few men, I had a couple of pictures of bands that he played in at the time, and I would ask them questions concerning the fellas in the band.

ctx.x: I don't like to bother you as much about your uncle, but since he's not here, that's really to talk to himself. If you can remember anything else he ever told you when you were a kid about the bands? He said he played with Buddy Bolden.
Did he ever tell you anything about Buddy Bolden or when he played with him?
